readout_other: multi-channel cortical LFP; phase lag index functional connectivity; graph theory metrics; seizure rate
direction_notes: TUS of the hippocampus reduced cortical LFP power, PLI connectivity and network strength and accelerated recovery from seizure state in penicillin-induced epileptic mice.
safety_notes: Temperature rise and MI were calculated theoretically (maximum 0.026 C, MI 0.33); no in vivo safety assessment is described.

timing.protocol_description: Fundamental frequency 1 MHz, PRF 500 Hz, duty cycle 50%, total intervention duration 15 min, acoustic pressure 0.33 MPa, delivered to awake mice 40 min after the pre-TUS baseline period.

source_quotes.n_subjects: were used in this experiment and were randomly divided into the TUS group (n = 10, female = 5, male = 5) and the Sham group $( { \mathfrak { n } } \ = \ 1 0$ , female = 5, male = 5).
